title: Democratizing Microscopy Analysis through an Online Collaborative Visualization Platform
content: Microscopy, a cornerstone of scientific inquiry, allows the exploration of micro and nanostructures critical to diverse scientific fields such as biology, materials science, and nanotechnology. The ability to visualize structures at these scales provides invaluable insights into the underlying principles governing various phenomena. However, the growing complexity and size of microscopy datasets pose significant challenges in visualization and analysis, often requiring expensive, specialized hardware and software. This limitation hinders accessibility and collaborative opportunities for researchers across different geographical locations.
